items.summary: Risk disposition: blocked, with counsel_required escalation. Evidence: Woot documentation confirms API access but not redistribution rights; current Woot terms restrict commercial/public use of listings, descriptions, prices, and derivatives. Security, accuracy/freshness, measurement, owner, and launch gates remain incomplete. Compliance is technical-only with 36 pass, 19 fail, and 6 unknown. Analytics is configured for the measured fleet, but this does not establish consent or jurisdictional sufficiency. Revenue evidence is limited to 2026-09-21; $4.92 aggregate commission is unattributed and cannot support site claims. Exact decision: keep SearchWoot private, do not send rights outreach, do not enable affiliate/advertising use, and permit only bounded read-only evidence work plus ordinary reversible work that adds no new data collection or public exposure. Human counsel is required for Woot rights, privacy/jurisdiction, vendor terms, and any future affiliate or advertising use.

Tracking remains active. Four launch-readiness tasks are open; none are closed because required evidence is absent. Existing evidence progress: Woot API documentation, public terms, support guidance, partial data-flow files, privacy/cookie pages, and draft terms are recorded. Missing evidence remains authoritative source permission, field-level rights, retention/deletion/correction workflows, deployed consent behavior, GA4 settings, vendor/DPA review, log inventory, and incident/request procedures. Next evidence action: attach one dated read-only bundle containing the repository/config data-flow table, vendor/log inventory, consent/configuration capture, and unresolved counsel questions to the existing checklist. Do not contact Woot or change the private gate.
